purpose: Verify sealed chronological experiment structure without admitting data or performance claims

lifecycle.idea: Seal data identity, parameters and chronological splits before evaluation
lifecycle.source: Book-driven research route and project research methodology
lifecycle.hypothesis: A fail-closed gate detects altered data, overlap, wrong order and unsealed OOS
lifecycle.result: VALID_MODELLED_ONLY; 4/4/4 bars; all claims remain closed
lifecycle.critique: Twelve modelled bars cannot establish a defensible research horizon or embargo
lifecycle.decision: Accept gate mechanics; do not promote M0/S2 or BOT-RULE-101
lifecycle.lesson: Predregistration is a separate gate from data admission and strategy evidence

limitations: Four bars per split have no statistical meaning
Zero embargo is a contract fixture, not a historical recommendation
Dataset license, market semantics and quality are not proved
lessons: Do not open OOS while developing a strategy
Count embargo in observations, not calendar gaps
A valid plan does not make an invalid dataset tradable
